build_incremental_decoder: build a python module that subclasses FairseqIncrementalDecoder to implement custom incremental decoding logic
implement_forward_method: implement the forward method in a FairseqIncrementalDecoder subclass to process prev_output_tokens with encoder_out
implement_extract_features: implement the extract_features method in a FairseqIncrementalDecoder subclass to return decoder features and model outputs
reorder_incremental_state: reorder incremental state during beam search by calling reorder_incremental_state with a new_order tensor
set_beam_size: set the beam size on a FairseqIncrementalDecoder and all its child modules using set_beam_size
